name: Dross Pits
description: Sheoldred's territory on New Phyrexia, where she ran a grand coliseum.

timeline.summary: Mirrodin is compleated into New Phyrexia and the Mephidross is siphoned into the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: siphoned out entirely into a new layer within Phyrexia, the Dross Pits

citation.work: Mephidross
citation.text: "Mephidross", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred takes control of the Dross Pits after deceiving Roxith.
timeline.quote: after falling for Sheoldred's deception, she took control of it

citation.work: New Phyrexia (plane)
citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri cleaves Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Since Nahiri cleaved it from the Dross Pits , Sheoldred's Coliseum now rests in this layer.

citation.work: New Phyrexia (plane)
citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred outsmarts Roxith, who is killed when he fails to access one of her coffers, and establishes her territory in the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: She outsmarted Roxith when he failed to access one of her coffers and was killed.

citation.work: Sheoldred
citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Sheoldred's domain, and Sheoldred then serves Norn in the multiversal invasions.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain.

citation.work: Sheoldred
citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "Mirran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret carries Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret carried Sheoldred back to her lair in the Dross Pits.

citation.work: Sheoldred
citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixhel flies up the Basilica's shaft from the Dross Pits, killing skitterlings on the way, to report her success.
timeline.quote: as you separate their heads from their bodies with a sweep of your spear

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel treks across the Dross Pits and finds a rock gate with sound plates in front of Geth's fortress.
timeline.quote: Stepping into the shadow of the rock face, you see the outline of a gate.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel pins a stammering aspirant who says he is Belaxis and has a contract with Lord Geth, whom he calls the Thane of Contracts.
timeline.quote: Lord Geth makes deals. That's why they call him the Thane of Contracts!

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Belaxis helps Ixhel crack the sound puzzle to open the gate and she gives him her name.
timeline.quote: The door flashes with a thin blue light, and the gate grinds open.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel walks through Geth's holding, noting the many aspirants and incompleat creatures, and reaches his fortress and empty throne.
timeline.quote: you do see more aspirants than you have in a long time.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel decides to help Geth's head and carries it to the Dominus of Pain.
timeline.quote: Maybe, in this, you can help him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel impales Belaxis on a spike of the Dominus of Pain, saying she is grateful.
timeline.quote: A piercing wail rings out across the wastes as you pin the writhing body in your arms down onto a razor-tipped spoke

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel brings Vishgraz to the Dross Pits shaft and tells him to go, and he urges her to come; she refuses and calls him her first defiance.
timeline.quote: You are my first defiance. Now go.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Ixhel stays at the base of the shaft, feeling an ache to follow him, but does not.
timeline.quote: Deep in the center of you is an ache that wishes to follow him.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The carts plunge down the tunnel and Elspeth chats with the Mirran operators about the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay the team is bypassing.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex transported the worst of it beneath the surface during the great transformation

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the thanes of the Dross Pits, four of whom support Urabrask's rebellion, so the team can use the chaos for cover.
timeline.quote: Seven thanes rule the Dross Pits, but they've never been united.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth distributes Halo, and Jace collapses after drinking his dose.
timeline.quote: the bottle slipping from his fingers before he collapsed backward onto the cart behind him

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes and tries to run off, saying Vraska is in pain and calling to him.
timeline.quote: She made it down here, and she's alone and she's scared.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace uses illusions so that Phyrexians locked in civil war cannot see the group as they cross the battlefield.
timeline.quote: When they look at us, they see nothing at all,

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tears apart Sheoldred's Coliseum with her last free breath.
timeline.quote: Nahiri's last free breath became a defiant roar as she tore apart Sheoldred's Coliseum.

citation.work: Nahiri's Sacrifice
citation.text: Nahiri's Sacrifice (Phyrexia: All Will Be One, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vishgraz's stolen limbs disobey; Atraxa brands it a heretic and Ixhel abandons it in the Dross Pits.
